rationale: The short thesis required continued distribution toward 31.80, but price has instead based, reclaimed the 9-EMA (32.68), and printed four consecutive higher closes while 5-min ATR compressed to $0.03 — making a ~2.9% drop in the remaining 51 minutes statistically implausible without a catalyst. With only 3 bps of favorable excursion achieved and price 6 cents from the 32.79 invalidation while grinding upward, the likely outcome is a stop-out for a larger loss than closing now at ~$30 on a 3 bps spread. The evidence for the opposite direction (a 0.4% drift off the lows on light volume, price still above session VWAP) is not meaningfully strong enough to justify a flip.
